description: Source gap analysis, unaddressed bean varieties, and missing cooking parameters across NotebookLM sources.
summary_of_gaps: The notebook sources rely almost exclusively on canned, pre-cooked beans and chickpeas across soups, stews, chilis, and skillet warm-ups. As a result, critical raw/dry bean preparation techniques are missing.

uncovered_aspects.detail: No source provides soaking times, water-to-bean ratios, or guidance on overnight cold soaking vs quick hot soaking for dried legumes.
Cooking times from dry beans from scratch (ranging typically from 45 to 90 minutes) are completely absent. All recipe times assume canned, drained beans.

uncovered_aspects.topic: Pressure cooker / Instant Pot dry bean conversions
uncovered_aspects.detail: While Instant Pot Pasta e Fagioli is referenced in recipe roundups, exact pressure cooking times and natural release protocols for unsoaked or soaked dry beans are not specified.

uncovered_aspects.topic: Phytohaemagglutinin toxin safety for red kidney beans
uncovered_aspects.detail: No sources warn about the necessary 10-minute rapid boil requirement to destroy lectins/phytohaemagglutinin in raw dry kidney beans before slow cooking.

app_recommendation: The app engine should default to canned, drained beans for quick weeknight dinners. If a user selects raw dried beans, external hydration and boil times must be supplied.
